svg.text: Covenant — in-perimeter AI inference governance & FinOps control plane
Every request passes the same ordered governance pipeline; the hash-chained audit log is the evidence of record, everything else is a derived view.
Customer perimeter — no prompt, response, or metadata leaves; egress only to the allow-listed models
Covenant appliance — single .NET process, NativeAOT target
Audit stage — outermost; records allow, deny, and error alike
metadata + SHA-256 prompt fingerprint — never content
replayed from the log at boot
